decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program is reimbursed, builds on core psychiatric competence and serves working patients, so it likely meets aspirations, and the growing firm has slack to support it.
Outpatient sociotherapy complements the psychiatric offer, but staffing and financing are uncertain; results are not far enough below aspiration to trigger search while expansion provides slack.
Senior-living counseling is prominently featured and feeds clients into the core eldercare business, clearly meeting management's aspirations.
The retail shop's results remain uncertain after dropping the carpentry workshop, but it supports workshop sales and inclusion goals, and slack lets the firm carry it a while longer.
Meal delivery for seniors is newly launched, close to the eldercare core and in demand, so management will give it time while its results are still being assessed.
